title: NewPassportIssued
description: The content of the operation NewPassportIssued: the second-life operator tells the data provider of an original passport that a new passport was issued.

passportIdentifier.description: The passport identifier of the new passport.

catenaXId.description: The catenaXId of the digital twin of the new passport.

operation.description: The operation that issued the new passport.

operationDate.description: The date and time at which the new passport was issued.

predecessorPassportIdentifier.description: The passport identifier of the one original passport of the receiver that the notification concerns.
